text: All about rain: better info on page, better push data, better heavy rain alerts!
New text/view for rain descriptions in case it rains all day (don't be shy to send feedback!). General text, photo theme improvements.
Major improvements to the photo theme
New theme with my own photos that follow the time of day and weather (experimental!)
Rain alert improvements and preventing heavy rain spam. Work started on meteorological alerts!
Not showing moderate wind if it only happens in late night hours to make forecast more relevant.
Better icons for the forecast periods taking into account sunlight. And changelog!
Improved times on the rain graph and showing interval duration on tap. Fixed 'Updated' showing an older time than actual data fetch/calculation.
9:00 option for the morning forecast, visual improvements and improved rain graph.
Hour-by-hour temperatures now available. New locations added. Faster site loading and refresh-on-open. The UV index only shows from 3 up.
Custom morning forecast times and opt-out weekend notifications. Fixed morning forecast not using latest rain radar.
